# CANDIDATE: test-a-1dte-dte-override-for-the-vwap-continuation-setup-by-

**Filed:** 2026-09-07

**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Testing if overriding VWAP_CONTINUATION to 1DTE (weekly expiry) improves edge capture on J anchor days while maintaining acceptable walk-forward performance. The hypothesis is that 1DTE may better align with the intraday continuation signal than 0DTE by reducing theta decay and spread costs, while still capturing the morning bias.

## Mechanism

Set `j_vwap_cont_dte_override=1` to force 1DTE for VWAP_CONTINUATION setup. Adjust `_expiry_for_setup` to select the weekly expiry (Friday) when the override is active. Entry logic remains: first ≤10:30 ET bar continuing the trend of the first 3 RTH closes relative to session VWAP. Exit logic: chart-stop-only (session extreme against trade) with standard v15 TP1 (+50%), runner, chandelier profit-lock (trail 0.15), and 15:50 ET time stop.
